Record Class UcumEssence.Unit

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumEssence.Unit
Record Components:
code - the case-sensitive code
caseInsensitiveCode - the case-insensitive code
metric - whether the file marks it metric
special - whether the file marks it special
arbitrary - whether the file marks it arbitrary
unitClass - the class the file files it under
names - its names, one or more, in the file's order
printSymbol - the print symbol, empty when the file gives none
property - the property it measures
definitionValue - the number in its definition as written, empty for a special unit
definitionUnit - the unit in its definition as written
function - the function, for a special unit
Enclosing class:
UcumEssence
public static record UcumEssence.Unit(String code, String caseInsensitiveCode, boolean metric, boolean special, boolean arbitrary, String unitClass, List<String> names, String printSymbol, String property, String definitionValue, String definitionUnit, Optional<UcumEssence.Function> function) extends Record
One defined unit as the file writes it.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
